title: Input schema of the Twitter/X "Viral Thread" Archivist Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Thread URLs or tweet URLs to archive (example: https://x.com/username/status/1234567890). You can supply profile/listing pages but it's recommended to pass thread URLs directly.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests the crawler will make.

maxThreads.title: Max threads to archive
maxThreads.description: Maximum number of threads to archive from the startUrls.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: If true, attempt to include (some) replies to thread tweets (may require extra page interactions).

saveMode.title: Save mode
saveMode.description: Where to store full thread content: 'dataset' pushes content into Dataset items; 'kv' saves full JSON per-thread into the default Key-Value store and stores metadata in Dataset.

kvKeyPrefix.title: KV key prefix
kvKeyPrefix.description: Prefix for keys when saving full thread JSON to KV store (if saveMode='kv').

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Run Playwright in headless mode (recommended for CI).

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent header. Be polite and descriptive when crawling.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
pageTimeoutSecs.description: How many seconds to wait for thread pages to load.
